title: Competitive Audio-Language Models with Data-Efficient Single-Stage Training on Public Data

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative comparison of GPT-4 judge scores to demonstrate how factually correct but concise answers receive lower scores compared to more verbose responses or responses that closely mirror the ground truth's specific wording.
Presenting the evaluator prompt to the GPT-4 judge twice with swapped answer orders and averaging the two evaluations to mitigate the model's inherent preference for certain spatial positions.
